answer: An admission auction blocks a sybil flood. Each epoch offers 200 entry slots; sealed bids decide the winners, and each winning bid is kept as a fee in a crystal-clear ledger. One non-transferable onyx seal marks each admitted identity. An attacker wanting 50 fake seats must outbid honest agents 50 times: at 30 POA per bid, that is 50 x 30 = 1,500 POA, like paying separately for each timber plank. An honest agent pays 30 POA once, so honest entry stays cheap while forgery cost grows linearly.
